implementation: The thirty-fourth unmerged LibreCAD patch generalizes the default-off selected named-block path to a bounded ordered set of 1..128 unchanged planar default-style source LINEs, at most 128 across selected blocks. It snapshots only dependency-free candidate records with extension dictionaries, checks every typed source/publication/coverage and the complete ordered source membership, and requires each staged LINE identity and BLOCK_RECORD owner at finalization. Unqualified, missing, duplicated, edited, hidden or nonplanar members refuse the whole save. Preview and units snapshots remain bounded and must match.
validation: A locally authored two-line source was converted by ODA to AC1024 DWG SHA-256 8eeb867599aa28b5a60c8a5ce0e9f7ebced938d1a810e16dc589fba041f62ac2. LibreDWG independently reports both ordered BLOCK_HEADER members, each owned by block 30 with coordinates (1,2,0)-(3,4,0) and (-2,5,0)-(6,-1,0).

The LibreCAD two-line test passed 28 assertions, including duplicate source identity and visibility-change refusal with destination preservation, same-filter retry, ordered fresh readback and the sort table. The same test passed 28 assertions on a locally authored combined source DWG SHA-256 3123526292931d72c381be18296403c278c8f99e702d6959390bb9161f6fe360 containing both lines, units=4 and an exact 56-byte preview. A mixed planar/nonplanar source SHA-256 3a7e2d88e9bc8b41928bb58ff7e49b12cac1e3fbd9a95a1f2302d9694d0c5acc passed six refusal/preservation assertions. All three installed-codec focused CTests pass.
A standalone consumer matched ordered two-line source membership, rejected reversed membership and verified capture-allocation failure/reset/retry for both block and line snapshots.

The ordinary and combined LibreCAD ASCII DXFs have SHA-256 b33c55a7e71f5b3aa07621176d33924393ccce63f18e5b4292384277890d3c5b and 1ef7e28e174c0008d312f16747569d630459e037d853ffc5e7267fa0666756c4. ezdxf confirms both LINE owners, coordinates and dictionary/sort links with zero audit errors/fixes; the combined output physically retains the exact preview bytes and units=4. ODA roundtrip DXFs have SHA-256 041a72a24e7651b384cfff3cc0aa789c716e528a9f6d1bd3c80632225798768f and 1768745af25b06f204806fecba695f70eb5bd640f18daff3fcaaeadfb9eb014a; LibreDWG verifies both line owners/coordinates and exact preview and units in the combined intermediate DWG.

The patch applies after the prior 33 patches and the older bundled-codec filter compiles. Source-release inventory passes with 1231 files and 18 refusal controls; the 725-input implementation digest remains d2fbf3b7e98738e05bc8f6a097b74ee429b43f58bcc8988a7bc92e6554a539c7.
limits: The implementation has a 128-line bound, but physical peer qualification here covers one- and two-line locally authored AC1024 examples only. The option is default-off and programmatic. Other entity types, richer styles, changed geometry, 3D lines, large blocks, title metadata, native AutoCAD/FreeCAD semantics and full graph closure remain open. No drawing fixture was committed and no support claim is promoted.
